requirements.title: BLOCK specifications declare BLOCK-scope construct entities except scoped ASYNCHRONOUS, IMPORT, and VOLATILE cases
requirements.definition: Except for ASYNCHRONOUS, IMPORT, and VOLATILE statements, specifications in a BLOCK construct declare construct entities whose scope is that of the BLOCK construct. If an object name that is not a construct entity appears in ASYNCHRONOUS or VOLATILE in a BLOCK construct, the object has that attribute within the construct even if it does not outside.
